Attached: 1 image

I've been obsessed with the idea of nested notes forever. Here's a screenshot of a DOS program I wrote in the year 2000 (!) called ThoughtDiary that let you write notes that you could navigate into and add subnotes to.

I forgot I wrote up a tutorial even for this little program to illustrate the concepts. Note the use of two spaces after a period.

#msdos #dos #productivity #retrocomputing
